description.value: The caster emulates a Chimera Brain by breathing out a shredding flurry of icy slivers hitting all creatures within a 30-ft.-line. Creatures in the area of effect take 14d6 points of ice damage and are inflicted with Frozen status for 1d4 rounds. A successful Reflex save reduces the damage by half and negates the status effect. Learned From Chimera Family, White Dragon Family, Kaiser Dragon, Ser Haumeric, and Mammoth Family
